mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_item ( batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at, failure_code, failure_message ) SELECT #{batchId}, ke.exchange_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM krw_exchange ke INNER JOIN sell_order so ON so.order_id = ke.order_id WHERE ke.settlement_status = 'PROVISIONAL' AND ke.final_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ke.final_at AS DATE) <= CAST(#{executedAt} AS DATE) AND so.status = 'EXECUTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item existing_item WHERE existing_item.batch_id = #{batchId} AND existing_item.exchange_id = ke.exchange_id ) ORDER BY ke.exchange_id
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM settlement_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND result IS NULL AND item_id > #{itemId} ORDER BY item_id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_item SET result = #{result}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND result IS NULL AND processed_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlement_item SET result = #{result}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND result IS NULL AND processed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_item (batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at, failure_code, failure_message) SELECT #{batchId}, failed.exchange_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM settlement_item failed WHERE failed.item_id = #{itemId} AND failed.batch_id = #{batchId} AND failed.result = 'FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item succeeded WHERE succeeded.exchange_id = failed.exchange_id AND succeeded.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item pending WHERE pending.exchange_id = failed.exchange_id AND pending.result IS NULL )

INSERT INTO settlement_item (batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at, failure_code, failure_message) SELECT latest.batch_id, latest.exchange_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM settlement_item latest WHERE latest.batch_id = #{batchId} AND latest.result = 'FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item newer WHERE newer.batch_id = latest.batch_id AND newer.exchange_id = latest.exchange_id AND newer.item_id > latest.item_id )
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM settlement_item WHERE item_id = #{itemId} FOR UPDATE
